reuse.why: Reuses findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse, bankSync.syncAccount and extracts clearAccountLink for unlinkAccount, but the new generic linkBankSyncAccount is used only by Fintegra while the five existing link handlers keep their own copies.

duplication.why: linkBankSyncAccount re-creates the upgrade/insert/payee/sync/notify body of the five existing link functions, downloadFintegraTransactions copies the EnableBanking/Akahu download function, and the assert+claim preamble is pasted into six handlers.

placement.why: Link rules live in server/accounts/app.ts next to the handlers, download in sync.ts, server path in server-config.ts, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps; the extraction of clearAccountLink is a small justified refactor.

maintainability.why: claimBankAccount and assertUpgradingAccountNotClosed centralise the new rules well, but there are now two link-flow styles (generic helper vs five hand-written copies) and every handler must remember to call both guards.

bypasses_abstraction.where: linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount do not use the new linkBankSyncAccount; downloadFintegraTransactions re-implements the provider download pattern

disguised_duplication.where: linkBankSyncAccount is a generalised reshaping of the per-provider link bodies that are left in place; downloadFintegraTransactions mirrors downloadEnableBankingTransactions with renamed result construction

abstraction_drift.where: replaceExistingLink added to LinkAccountBaseParams/claimBankAccount; fintegra special cases added to processBankSyncDownload (akahu || fintegra) and syncAccount dispatch; five existing link handlers bypass linkBankSyncAccount
